What matters most before buying

Compatibility: Base M1/M2/M3 MacBooks generally require special software or hardware to drive two independent external displays.

Resolution: At this budget, I would favor 2K panels over 1080p, particularly for coding and reading.

Weight: Extenders can weigh several pounds, so a freestanding kickstand is preferable to hanging everything off the laptop lid.

Connectivity: Verify whether your USB-C ports support video output and whether the extender requires a driver.

These recommendations are based on published specifications and current listings, not my own hands-on testing.
